methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.intro: How a newsletter becomes a documented offer. We show the method because trust requires transparency — not because a score should look official.
methodology.pipeline1: The platform subscribes to companies' public marketing newsletters using controlled addresses.
methodology.pipeline2: Received messages are normalized and fingerprinted. Raw content is private.
methodology.pipeline3: The extractor ({version}) finds offers and extracts structured fields — each with an exact source excerpt and a confidence.
methodology.pipeline4: A human editor confirms, edits or marks unknown in Review Studio. Without traceable evidence, no verified fact.
methodology.pipeline5: The system matches against existing offers in layers (company, type, claim, terms, time). Material changes create a new offer version.
methodology.pipeline6: Verification is not publication. Publication is an explicit act, and only approved structured content reaches public pages.
methodology.matchingBody: We do not trust a single similarity score. Matching weighs company, offer type, normalized claim, commercial terms and temporal proximity — and an editor can always override the suggestion.
methodology.recognitionBody: {label} is awarded to a concrete offer version when promise, price, period and key terms are verified as documented, and community observations do not contradict the picture. The method is versioned and public. The status cannot be bought and implies no legal judgment.
methodology.communityBody: Members answer structured factual questions about campaigns they received themselves — one question at a time, typically around 20 seconds. No star ratings, no free-text accusations. We aggregate concrete observations, not sentiment.
methodology.privacyBody: Raw newsletters, full subject lines and delivery metadata are private. Public pages show only approved structured facts, selected evidence excerpts, history and aggregated observations. Personal email data never becomes raw material for business products.
methodology.noLegalBody: The system never calls anything illegal, fraud or deceptive. We document what was promised and what actually applies — with evidence.
methodology.versionsBody: When price, period, eligibility or terms change, we create a new version of the same offer instead of a new offer. Changes are stored as first-class objects with old value, new value and evidence reference.
about.title: About
about.missionBody: We are building a living, historical market map of what companies promise, what actually applies, and how commercial offers change over time.
about.framing: From ephemeral marketing to permanent market memory.
about.framingBody: Marketing changes and disappears. The record should not. The market leaves traces — we make them readable, layer by layer.
about.whatBody: The core unit is the concrete offer — not the company as a whole. We combine versioned offer data, evidence and provenance, factual community confirmations, positive offer-level recognition and historical change tracking.
about.whatNotBody: Not a review site, not a coupon site, not a price comparison clone, not a compliance certification and not an automatic legal judge.
about.brandBody: {name} is a working name under validation. The final brand is not locked. Prototype/MVP stage, Denmark first.
